title: Haifa, Kafr Samir
version: Hadashot Arkheologiyot–Excavations and Surveys in Israel 119, 10 July 2007, official English and Hebrew report with figures.
lineage: Primary field report for the 1991–1995 surveys. Fig. 3 repeats the underwater scene in the 1997 paper's Fig. 5. Figs. 3–5 show the fragments and sketch published as KS 2 by Rosenberg et al. in 2023.

passages.locator: Survey introduction and winter 1994 account, Figs. 3–5
passages.note: Three waterlogged, pair-twined twig fragments were excavated from a 0.90 m diameter, 0.55 m deep pit about 65 m west of a paved area. The fill had dozens of olive stones. The survey finds were taken to the Israel Museum laboratories for treatment.
The authors give 5000–4730 cal BCE from the braiding itself. The report gives a sample code but omits the fragment sampled, uncalibrated age, pretreatment, calibration curve and probability.
The excavators propose an aqal-like pressing container. A separate crushed-stone oil installation lay several dozen metres south of the basket pit.
